output:

- Interested in live plants, especially Java Moss and Anacharis; care details provided (lighting, pH, fertilization, copper-medication caution).
- Gourami feeding-time aggression noted earlier; hiding places still part of plan.
- Already has artificial coral and rocks; on 2023/05/28 asked whether to add a treasure chest or sunken ship decoration for more neon tetra hiding spots.
